decision.generation_failure_repair_behavior: Use the generation-failure artifact hash as the parent binding and an explicit no-program marker in the next-round repair prompt.

reason: Round 0 contained two generation timeouts with structured feedback but no parent program file.
The frozen controller required a parent program for every feedback-ready case and would terminate before producing any Round 1 prompts.
Treating the next call as the already-budgeted Round 1 repair preserves the fixed one-attempt initial-generation protocol and the maximum two-round repair budget.
The parent binding remains auditable because the repair plan records the immutable generation-failure artifact hash from the Round 0 manifest.
